1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component adapted to be anchored in a humerus bone and said second component is a removably attached stem.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface and said second component is a removably attached stem, wherein said removably attached stem has a variable length.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and wherein said humeral surface is adapted to provide a smooth articulating surface.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface is spherically or elliptically shaped and is adapted to provide a smooth articulating surface.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a variable length wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus, and is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 20 wherein said humeral surface connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw, and is adapted to provide a smooth articulating surface.
